title: Template:RecipeCoinLine
text: Row template for RecipeBox. Shows only the coin row (mode = currency) of a recipe, as Gold / Silver / Copper. All other rows are skipped. Called after Template:RecipeMaterialLine so the coins end up at the bottom.
